description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates how to create a custom ActionProvider for the action bar, specifically to launch system settings via a menu item and an embedded button.

classes.name: ActionBarSettingsActionProviderActivity
classes.description: Android activity demonstrating custom ActionProvider usage for settings.

classes.name: SettingsActionProvider
classes.description: Custom ActionProvider class that creates an action view with a button to launch system settings.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu resource into the activity's options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, providing a toast message when an item is clicked.

methods.name: SettingsActionProvider.<init>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a context.

methods.name: SettingsActionProvider.onCreateActionView
methods.description: Creates the action view layout, sets up a button with a click listener to launch system settings.

methods.name: SettingsActionProvider.onPerformDefaultAction
methods.description: Launches system settings when the action provider's default action is invoked.
